theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U N E : Set (Euclid P)) (ξN : Euclid P → MultiVector P (n + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (xs : ℕ → Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ i, 0 < lams i) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → InClassO n U N ξN → MeasurableSet E → E ⊆ N ∩ U → IsBoundaryOfRegion T E ξN → x ∈ U → Tendsto xs atTop (𝓝 x) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → (∃ C r₀ : ℝ, 0 < r₀ ∧ ∀ y ∈ ball x r₀, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < r₀ → T.massOn (ball y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ρ ^ n)) → ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T (xs i) (lams i) (hlams i).ne') S → S.support.Nonempty → ∃ (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a : Euclid P) (F : Set (Euclid P)) (ξA : MultiVector P (n + 1)), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n + 1 ∧ InClassO n (univ : Set (Euclid P)) {y | y + a ∈ Q} (fun _ => ξA) ∧ MeasurableSet F ∧ F ⊆ {y | y + a ∈ Q} ∧ IsBoundaryOfRegion S F (fun _ => ξA)
